map.选择矩形、L形、梯形、圆形或三角形等房间形状，输入相应尺寸即可计算面积与周长，辅: Choose a room shape such as rectangle, L-shape, trapezoid, circle or triangle, enter the matching dimensions, and the tool computes the area and perimeter to help estimate tile and wallpaper quantities and plan the layout for home decoration.
map.矩形房 长 × 宽 直接得面积，再乘地砖单块面积（800×800=0.64㎡）估: For a rectangular room, multiply length × width for the area, then divide by the area of one floor tile (800×800 = 0.64 m²) to estimate the tile count, plus wastage.
map.L 形拆两个矩形求和；梯形用 (上底 + 下底) × 高 ÷ 2；圆形用 πr²: Split an L-shape into two rectangles and sum them; for a trapezoid use (top + bottom) × height ÷ 2; for a circle use πr². Each suits a different room layout.
map.不规则房用「包围盒 − 缺口」近似，或分块累加，快速估壁纸 / 地板用量。: For an irregular room, approximate it with the bounding box minus the notch, or sum the pieces, to estimate wallpaper and flooring quantities quickly.
map.：矩形 4×3.5=14㎡，800×800 砖 0.64㎡/块 → 14÷0.6: A 4×3.5 rectangle is 14 m², and an 800×800 tile is 0.64 m², so 14÷0.64 ≈ 22 tiles, plus 5% wastage ≈ 23 tiles. The L-shape is 3×2 + 2×1.5 = 6+3 = 9 m². The perimeter is used for wall paint and baseboards: a rectangular perimeter = 2×(length + width).
map.损耗加多少？: How much wastage should I add?
map.地砖 5%、墙砖 8–10%（切角多）、壁纸 10–15%；异形房间取高值。本工: Floor tiles 5%, wall tiles 8-10% (more cuts), wallpaper 10-15%; take the high end for irregular rooms. This tool gives the net area, and wastage is added at purchase time.
map.周长用来算什么？: What is the perimeter used for?
map.墙面刷漆、踢脚线、阴角线均按周长 × 层高（或线宽）计。矩形周长 = 2×(长+: Wall paint, baseboards and internal corner trims are all measured as perimeter × height (or line width). For a rectangle the perimeter = 2×(length + width); for an L-shape, add up each segment of the outer outline.
